Could u point some article explaining how it will work? so will ETH2 beacon chain and shards support running modern smartcontracts? will current blockchain become ETH beacon chain or a shard? Ethereum will continue being Ethereum. With The Merge the consensus mechanism will change from PoW to PoS, and people will now need to run two pieces of software side by side instead of a single piece of software. the merge will ship along with sharded chains or the sharding is planned after the merge? nice 🙂 https://ethereum.org/en/eth2/ says first it will be moved to in 2021 then in 2022 shards will be created Sharding is still under active research, it will not be available as of The Merge.
